metadata.title: Seven Methods for Soft-Constraint Quadratic Programming: Contracts and Two Negative Timing Studies
metadata.description:
Soft constraints price departures from selected operating preferences while preserving immutable physical limits. We describe a reproducible convex quadratic optimization system that makes the original objective, physical units, method compatibility and numerical evidence inspectable. Seven implemented paths cover explicit slack lifting, published generalized projection, side-specific DAQP weights, a fixed FlexQP reconstruction, ElastiQP, a side-specific interval proximal update and a directional disjoint group-peak update. Eighteen versioned contracts connect synthetic input generation, native execution, independent original-space evaluation, local request/result exchange and verified static presentation. Fifteen authored or source-faithful model cases exercise scalar semantics, mixed hard/soft policy, sparse structure, predictive control and building energy. A separate registered computation contains 456 seeded instances, retaining 11592 accepted and 7560 incompatible measured observations across 600 timing cells with recorded counts, medians and interquartile ranges. Its 168-pair held-out median relative cold end-to-end reduction is 0.499839%, with a 95% seed-cluster interval from -3.291967% to 3.944835%. A second computation retains all 210 grouped repeated-forecast inputs and 7770 raw observations. Its complete 144-member held-out primary score is -212.449875%, with interval limits -225.336618% and -192.873759%, including 9 failed pairs. Neither registered ten-percent improvement criterion is established. Equivalent formulations, physical covariance, objective/dual checks and retained failure states distinguish mathematical agreement from elapsed-time advantage. The system supports transparent research and development; the synthetic evidence does not establish operational safety, measured field benefit or algorithmic priority.

Editable LaTeX sources and code: CAOS_SoftQP. Native engine: CAOS_SoftQP_Engine. Complete grouped evidence: dataset.
metadata.version_notes: Corrected native report. Includes exact fixed-workspace FlexQP equations and limits, source provenance and all 600 retained timing cells. The registered timing conclusions remain negative.
